checklist_store_description: A contact email shoppers can write to, and your legal details.
checklist_market_description: The countries you sell to and their currency.
checklist_shipping_description: A zone with a rate, so physical products can be delivered.
checklist_payment_description: Cash on delivery or a bank transfer: checkout is refused without one.
checklist_stock_description: Set stock at a location, or leave stock untracked.
checklist_publish_description: A storefront sells what's published to its channel.
checklist_key_description: The publishable key your storefront calls the API with.
title: Set up your store
description: Six steps to a storefront that can take orders. Each saves as you go; leave and come back, and it opens where you were.
all_done_title: Your store is ready to sell
all_done_description: Every step is done. Finish to put the guide away; Settings → Store can show it again.
step_done_description: Change or add to it below, or go on.
step_store_why_name: Your storefront shows the store's name and the email shoppers can write to.
step_store_why_time_zone: The time zone decides how dates show; everything is stored in UTC.
step_store_why_language: The language says what your content is written in. Translations come later.
step_market_description: Where you sell, in which currency
step_market_why_group: A market is a group of countries that buy in one currency.
step_market_why_one_market: Each country belongs to one market at most; add more markets for other currencies.
step_market_why_catalog: A market sells the products in its catalog, created with it.
step_shipping_description: A zone and a flat rate
step_shipping_why_zone: Checkout offers the options of the zone the address is in.
step_shipping_why_flat_rate: Start with one flat rate; tiers by weight or order value, and carrier rates, are in Settings → Shipping.
step_payment_why_refused: Checkout refuses carts with something to pay until a payment method is enabled.
step_payment_why_manual: With cash on delivery or a bank transfer you collect the money yourself, then mark the order paid.
step_payment_why_instructions: Instructions (bank details, what to pay the courier) are shown to the shopper after checkout.
step_product_why_variant: A product starts with one variant; options like size and colour are added on its page.
step_product_why_stock: Leave stock blank to not track it: it can always be sold.
step_product_why_active: Drafts can't be sold, so the product is made active.
step_sell_description: Publish it and connect a storefront
step_sell_why_channel: A sales channel is where products are sold; a storefront sells what's published to its channel.
step_sell_why_key: The storefront calls the API with a publishable key. It's safe in a storefront's settings, but shown only once.
store_email_description: Where shoppers can write to you. Storefronts show it.
store_language_description: A BCP 47 tag: en, en-GB, hr…
store_currency_description: What you pay suppliers and your stock's value are kept in. Needed before you record a cost.
store_more: Legal details and a description are in Settings → Store.
market_name_description: For staff only; shoppers see their country.
market_countries_description: A country belongs to one market at most. Selling everywhere? Pick all available.
market_currency_description: What its prices are in. It can't change later.
market_prices_include_tax_description: On for most of Europe; off where tax is added at checkout, as in the US.
market_without_catalog: The market was added, but not its catalog: {error}
needs_market_description: This step uses the market's countries and currency.
shipping_countries_description: A country is in one zone at most.
shipping_rate_invalid: Enter the rate as a number, like 5 or 4.90.
shipping_zone_without_rate: The zone was added, but not its rate: {error}
payment_line_off: {name} (off: turn it on in Settings → Payments)
payment_instructions_description: Shown to the shopper after checkout.
product_unsellable_title: None of your first active products can be sold yet
product_unsellable_description: Set stock on a product's page, or add one here with stock.
product_title_description: Its handle (the URL) is made from it; both can change on its page.
product_market_description: It's added to this market's catalog.
product_track_on: Counted at a warehouse; it can't be sold once it runs out.
product_track_off: Not counted: it can always be sold, as for made-to-order or digital goods.
product_price_invalid: Enter the price as a number, like 18 or 18.50.
product_stock_invalid: Enter the stock on hand as a whole number, or turn off tracking.
product_partly_catalog: “{title}” was created as a draft, but not added to {market}: {error}
product_partly_stock: “{title}” was created as a draft, but its stock wasn't set: {error}
product_partly_stock_unknown: “{title}” was created as a draft, but its stock wasn't set.
product_partly_status: “{title}” was created as a draft, but it wasn't activated: {error}
sell_connect_has_key: You have a storefront key already; make another for a second storefront.
sell_connect_no_key: A publishable key for the storefront that sells through this channel.
sell_key_copy_description: The key is shown only once.
sell_key_where: It goes in the storefront's {setting} setting ({file} when you run it locally).
